paite: TOUPA muangte tuh Zion tang hihlin vual louh, tangtawn a om gige ding bang ahi.
heading: Pathian Mite Bitna

paite: Tangte, Jerusalem kim a a-om bang in amite kim ah TOUPA a-om hi. Tu a kipan tangtawn in.
Gilou-salou lalchiang midiktat tan tung ah akinga kei ding a; midiktatte'n akhut ua thulimlouhna akhoih kei uleh.
TOUPA aw, hoihtak a omte tung ah hoihtak in hih in, alungtang ua diktak a omte tung ah.
Alampi kawi ua pialte bel TOUPA'N thil hihkhialte toh apikhe ding. Israelte tung ah khamuanna om hen.
